_about: Rules you may change. A search = one keyword in one place, for example 'dentist in Austin, TX'.
_country: The country code Google Maps searches in: us, ca, gb, au and so on.
_pages_per_search: More pages find more businesses per search. Each page costs credits.
_credits_per_page: What one Serper page costs on your plan. Check serper.dev, Dashboard.
_approval_above: A run that needs more credits than this waits for a person to approve it.
_max_batches_per_run: A run stops after this many batches. Run it again to do the rest.
_max_attempts: A search that fails is tried again on the next run, up to this many tries in total.
_keep_without_website: false: a business with no website is not saved (cold email needs a domain).
